card.name: Linking words in hormone therapy warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'for', 'or', 'from' in hormonal contraception and estrogen labels, just before a duration (seven days) or 'dementia'. Also 'first' in cycle-day instructions.

modes.label: Estrogen warning list
modes.description: The word 'or' joining cardiovascular disease and dementia in the do-not-use-for-prevention warning.
modes.example: Estrogens plus progestin therapy should not be used for the prevention of cardiovascular disease<< or>> dementia.

modes.label: Backup contraception timing
modes.description: 'for' or 'from' just before a seven-day backup period after starting or inserting a contraceptive.
modes.example: must be used<< for>> seven days.
